title: Moth Lights
summary: Ilse says Lumen Moths circle where the ground is rich. Follow them, dig there, and bring her what you find.
ask: Ilse: See the little lights at dusk? Lumen Moths. They circle wherever there's ore under the soil.
Ilse: My tonic wants iron in it. Follow the moths, dig where they circle, and bring me some.

steps.text: Follow the Lumen Moths to where they circle
steps.night: The Lumen Moths only gather in the dark.
start: Ilse: They gather out that way most nights. Go softly. They startle.
done: The moths spiral low over one patch of ground, as if they're listening to it.

steps.text: Dig where they circled and bring Ilse 3 Raw Iron
done: Ilse: Good iron. The moths never lie. People do, moths don't.
Ilse: Here, the first flask. A sip after dark and the night opens right up. It refills itself if you're patient.
